content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 2 x ingot (hard plastic), dense wire (BSCCO), [[gv:pellet_charged|Ionized Particles]], 8 x wire (Gold).
- [[gv:machine_precass|Precision Assembly Machine]] : 8 x [[gv:circuit_silicon|Printed Silicon Wafer]], 2 x dense wire (BSCCO), 4 x ingot (hard plastic), 4 x [[gv:pellet_charged|Ionized Particles]], 8 x wire (Gold), 250 mB helium4.

Used to make :
[[gv:capacitor_bismuth|Bismuth Capacitor]], [[gv:capacitor_spark|Spark Capacitor]], [[gv:circuit_controller_quantum|Quantum Computer]], [[gv:orbital_assembly_crystal_circuit|Orbital Assembly: Crystal Circuit Board]], [[gv:circuit_quantum|Quantum Processing Unit]].
